answer.original_source: Wendell Weeks, Corning Chairman, CEO and President, interviewed by Fox News Digital on 2026-07-01
answer.new_information: Management outlook with no catalog question or stored piece to attach to. The period is unstated ('over the coming years') and 'double our size' has no defined measure (headcount, revenue, or capacity) or baseline. It is a forward statement of intent, not a result. The 3,000-jobs and tenfold-capacity figures in the same article are a separate third-party report of the NVIDIA project with no completion date, so they are not the same claim and are not matched here.
answer.reason: The record is a CEO growth and hiring outlook with no period or measure defined, and there are no catalog questions or stored pieces to update. It moves no number, probability, or condition, so it is recorded as background only. It does not carry a distinct investment judgement that would warrant a new question.
